title: C# Question & Answers - Iterators
description: This section of our 1000+ C# MCQs focuses on iterators in C# Programming Language.

questions.question: What is an iterator?
questions.explanation: An iterator is a method, operator, or accessor that returns the members of a set of objects, one member at a time, from start to finish.
